title: 01 Release and verify recent workout context
acceptance: Exact reviewed reader committed; separately approved deployment; fresh chosen-harness seven-day owner read reports dates, provenance, gaps and zero writes; foreign-owner and stale/truncated negatives pass.

title: 02 Verify owner context coverage
acceptance: Owned goals, requirements, equipment, schedule, constraints and domain source counts have dated populated/missing/unavailable status; no assumptions are silently saved.

title: 03 Publish a versioned coaching playbook read
acceptance: Selected LLM retrieves reviewed current guidance with source version/hash, review date and supersession; Fitness Project material reconciled explicitly; no app-generated prescription authority.

title: 04 Expose metrics and assessments
acceptance: Fresh harness retrieves source sets and observations with date, units, protocol, confidence, derivation and comparability; unknown goals or estimates do not become measured outcomes.

title: 05 Preserve WHOOP event timing
acceptance: Authorized ingestion retains event intervals/timezone and source timing; local-day recovery attribution verified near UTC rollover/DST; legacy dates remain unverified; no reconnect/job changes bundled.

title: 06 Expose meals and nutrition context
acceptance: Fresh harness retrieves dated owned meals, targets, estimate/review status, provenance and incomplete coverage; source outage differs from no meals; no changes made.

title: 07 Qualify controlled write operations
acceptance: Narrow owner-bound operations reject identity overrides, stale versions and invalid input; idempotent retry causes one canonical change; uncertain outcomes reconcile; every write has a receipt and history.

title: 08 Confirm current athlete requirements
acceptance: User-approved goals, constraints, equipment, training days and preferences round-trip through validated writes and a fresh read; uncertain numeric targets remain explicit; no APEX hard coding.

title: 09 Save selected LLM plans and rationale
acceptance: User approves an LLM-authored proposal; Socius validates/persists versions and rationale without generating programming; a fresh conversation distinguishes proposed/accepted/history and exact context references.

title: 10 Log workout photos through chosen LLM
acceptance: Photo extraction is reviewed then saved with source/provenance and a receipt in the same user plane; retry is idempotent; corrections preserve history and next conversation retrieves actual work.

title: 11 Automatically log estimated meal photos
acceptance: Explicitly authorized photo creates one estimated meal log with provenance/confidence; optional refinement amends it with history; no mandatory second coach chat; ambiguous/error cases and duplicate retry are tested.

title: 12 Verify portability and owner pilot lifecycle
acceptance: Second approved harness retrieves equivalent versioned context without manual copying; reconnect, expiry, refresh, account mismatch and revocation behave as specified; no broad multi-user security claim.

title: 13 Retire embedded programming safely
acceptance: After replacement end-to-end proof and explicit release approval, embedded authoring is retired while historical plans, rationale, IDs, completed-work links and logging remain readable and intact.

title: 14 Add optional daily nutrition review
acceptance: Only after separate scheduling approval and local IANA timezone confirmation, one 7:30 PM local review per day arrives in chosen user plane with DST/deduplication behavior; no reminder created by this plan.
